reading.title: The Weather Station 1: A short reading
reading.text: The morning begins with sunshine and a clear sky. A warm breeze moves through the garden. Later, clouds arrive and a little drizzle falls. By lunchtime, a downpour leaves a puddle near the gate. Maya waits indoors, then checks the road before walking to the bus stop with Omar.
